research_question: Can correcting the gold opportunity-cost driver ontology and using a causal meta-trust veto improve the H20 RTQ signal without converting weak evidence into forced UP/DOWN calls?

source.gold_endpoint: XAU/USD exact 13:29 America/New_York research cache bar

legacy_fx_correction.actual_semantics: Chinese Yuan Renminbi to U.S. Dollar exchange rate; it must not be interpreted as a broad U.S. dollar factor
legacy_fx_correction.policy: legacy RTQ remains an exact benchmark only; the driver-corrected parent excludes legacy fx_level/fx_logdiff from its feature surface

corrected_public_driver_reconstruction.provider: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

series.DFII10: 10-Year Treasury Inflation-Indexed Security Constant Maturity real yield

corrected_public_driver_reconstruction.retrieval: fredgraph CSV downloaded during the research run with payload SHA256 and retrieval timestamp recorded
corrected_public_driver_reconstruction.join_rule: strict previous economic source date only; same-date driver observation is forbidden
corrected_public_driver_reconstruction.evidence_warning: historical economic-date reconstruction retrieved in 2026; not contemporaneously archived prospective PIT evidence

LEGACY_RTQ_R126.definition: exact H20 rolling-126 RTQ baseline inherited from V1.56/V1.58

DRIVER_RTQ_R126.definition: same RTQ model and maturity geometry as LEGACY_RTQ_R126, but remove legacy generic fx_level/fx_logdiff and add strictly lagged broad USD and 10Y real-yield features

rtq_model.direction_rule: q25>0 => UP; q75<0 => DOWN; otherwise NO_SIGNAL
rtq_model.quantile_rearrangement: sort independently estimated q25/q50/q75 before applying the direction rule

meta_target.definition: for a parent RTQ origin that emitted UP or DOWN, 1 if that parent direction equals the matured H20 direction, else 0
meta_target.maturity_rule: at meta origin t, a prior parent prediction j may enter training only if j+20<=t; no unmatured parent correctness label may be consumed

routing.rule: if parent RTQ has a direction and p(parent_correct)>=0.60, keep parent direction; otherwise NO_SIGNAL
routing.reversal_policy: V1.59 may veto/abstain only; it may not flip an RTQ direction

evaluation.ontology_ablation_question: Does META_DRIVER_LOGIT outperform META_BASE_LOGIT on proper trust scores and/or final direction quality without sacrificing the 2026 preservation gate?
